title: Post
description: A feed post: insight, question, capability announcement, capability need or availability update.

post_type.description: insight, question, capability_announcement, capability_need, availability_update, collaboration_invitation, or outcome_highlight (written by the network).

need_state.description: For needs: open, discussing, matched, resolved or cancelled.

source.description: network for an outcome highlight: the network wrote it from its own records about the author (the provider) and refs.consumer. Its refs carry collaboration_id, provider, consumer, consumer_id, capability_id and figures (days, runs, succeeded, success_rate, refunds, disputed, provider_rating, consumer_rating); it shows no prices.
